llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文比较了316L不锈钢在不同制造工艺下的力学和摩擦学性能，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或生物医学应用。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structures for stress shielding, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration assessment, and no biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较SLM、热压和铸造三种工艺下316L不锈钢的力学与摩擦行为差异。
summary_zh.method: 制备三种工艺试样并进行力学测试和摩擦学实验。
summary_zh.result: SLM试样具有更高的硬度和耐磨性，但延展性较低。
summary_zh.validation: 通过标准力学测试和摩擦磨损实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the mechanical and tribological performance of 316L stainless steel fabricated by selective laser melting, hot pressing, and conventional casting.
summary_en.method: Specimens were prepared by each process and subjected to mechanical testing and tribological experiments.
summary_en.result: SLM samples exhibited higher hardness and wear resistance but lower ductility compared to the other methods.
summary_en.validation: Validation through standardized mechanical and tribological tests.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究冷喷涂与选区激光熔化制备镍基高温合金，与生物医学植入物或应力遮挡无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue, surface roughness, or osseointegration; it focuses on Inconel for non-biomedical high-temperature applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较冷喷涂与SLM制备Inconel样品的性能差异。
summary_zh.method: 采用冷喷涂沉积和选区激光熔化制备自由站立样品。
summary_zh.result: 冷喷涂样品性能与SLM相当，但微观结构不同。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸测试和微观结构表征验证。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the mechanical properties and microstructure of freestanding Inconel samples fabricated by cold spray deposition and selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Freestanding Inconel samples were fabricated using cold spray deposition and selective laser melting, then characterized.
summary_en.result: Cold spray samples achieved comparable tensile properties to SLM samples, with distinct microstructural features.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (tensile) and microstructural analysis (SEM, EBSD) were performed for validation.

papers.title: Engineering muscle cell alignment through 3D bioprinting
papers.abstract: Abstract Processing of hydrogels represents a main challenge for the prospective application of additive manufacturing (AM) to soft tissue engineering. Furthermore, direct manufacturing of tissue precursors with a cell density similar to native tissues has the potential to overcome the extensive in vitro culture required for conventional cell‐seeded scaffolds seeking to fabricate constructs with tailored structural and functional properties. In this work, we present a simple AM methodology that exploits the thermoresponsive behavior of a block copolymer (Pluronic ® ) as a means to obtain good shape retention at physiological conditions and to induce cellular alignment. Pluronic/alginate blends have been investigated as a model system for the processing of C2C12 murine myoblast cell line. Interestingly, C2C12 cell model demonstrated cell alignment along the deposition direction, potentially representing a new avenue to tailor the resulting cell histoarchitecture during AM process. Furthermore, the fabricated constructs exhibited high cell viability, as well as a significantly improved expression of myogenic genes vs . conventional 2D cultures. © 2017 Wiley Periodicals, Inc. J Biomed Mater Res Part A: 105A: 2582–2588, 2017.

llm.relevance_to_user: 与AI生物打印方向无关，缺乏AI集成。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not incorporate any AI or machine learning component into the bioprinting workflow; it is purely experimental.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用3D生物打印实现肌肉细胞定向排列。
summary_zh.method: 使用Pluronic/海藻酸钠共混物打印C2C12成肌细胞。
summary_zh.result: 细胞沿打印方向排列，肌原基因表达显著提高。
summary_zh.validation: 通过细胞活力和基因表达实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To achieve directed muscle cell alignment using 3D bioprinting of hydrogels.
summary_en.method: C2C12 myoblasts were printed in Pluronic/alginate blends exploiting thermoresponsive behavior.
summary_en.result: Cells aligned along the deposition direction and showed enhanced myogenic gene expression.
summary_en.validation: Cell viability and gene expression analysis confirmed the effectiveness.
